zh: 是；存在（系动词、助动词）；（名词）存在；本质

qs.en: I am a student in Paris.
I am ready to leave.
You are really brave!
Where are you from? Are you from Lyon?
He is my best friend.
The meeting is at ten o'clock.
We are all tired after the trip.
We agree with you.
You are welcome here.
You are late this morning.
They are all present today.
The children are in the garden.
I was very happy during this stay.
I was sick last week.

qs.s: ___ à la hauteur de la situation.
qs.en: You were up to the situation.
You were very patient with him.

qs.s: Le match ___ annulé à cause de la pluie.
qs.en: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
He was the best player on the team.
We were surprised by their reaction.
We have been very busy this month.
You have been very generous with us.
You were absent all day.
They were forced to come home early.
The results were published yesterday.

qs.s: Quand ___ enfant, j'habitais à la campagne.
qs.en: When I was a child, I lived in the countryside.

qs.s: ___ tellement fatigué que je me suis endormi.
qs.en: I was so tired that I fell asleep.

qs.s: ___ toujours le premier arrivé au bureau.
qs.en: You were always the first to arrive at the office.

qs.s: ___ en train de lire quand je t'ai appelé.
qs.en: You were reading when I called you.
The sky was clear that morning.

qs.s: ___ professeur avant de prendre sa retraite.
qs.en: He was a teacher before retiring.

qs.s: ___ dans la même classe à l'école.
qs.en: We were in the same class at school.
We were so happy to see you!

qs.s: ___ en vacances quand l'accident s'est produit.
qs.en: You were on holiday when the accident happened.

qs.s: ___ déjà au courant de la nouvelle.
qs.en: You were already aware of the news.

qs.s: ___ tous réunis autour de la table.
qs.en: They were all gathered around the table.

qs.s: Les rues ___ vides à cette heure-là.
qs.en: The streets were empty at that hour.
I will be back tomorrow evening.
I will be there to help you.
You will be a doctor in a few years.
You will be proud of this result.

qs.s: Le dîner ___ prêt à vingt heures.
qs.en: Dinner will be ready at eight o'clock.
He will be famous one day.
We will be at the office before nine.
We will always be there for you.
You will be informed as soon as possible.
You will be the first to know.

qs.s: ___ en mesure de répondre à la question.
qs.en: They will be able to answer the question.

qs.s: Les travaux ___ terminés la semaine prochaine.
qs.en: The works will be finished next week.
If I had the choice, I would be a pianist.
Without you, I would be lost.
In my place, you would be more careful.
With a little practice, you would be excellent.

qs.s: Il dit qu'il ___ ravi de vous rencontrer.
qs.en: He says he would be delighted to meet you.
Without help, this project would be impossible.
We would be honoured to welcome you.

qs.s: Avec plus de temps, ___ plus efficaces.
qs.en: With more time, we would be more efficient.
Would you agree to postpone the meeting?
Without your help, you would be at a dead end.

qs.s: Ils ___ ravis de participer à cet événement.
qs.en: They would be delighted to take part in this event.

qs.s: Ces mesures ___ plus efficaces avec davantage de ressources.
qs.en: These measures would be more effective with more resources.

qs.s: Il faut ___ à l'heure au rendez-vous.
qs.en: I need to be on time for the appointment.

qs.s: Elle veut ___ plus attentif en cours.
qs.en: She wants me to be more attentive in class.

qs.s: Je souhaite ___ heureux dans ta nouvelle vie.
qs.en: I wish you to be happy in your new life.

qs.s: Il est important ___ prudent sur la route.
qs.en: It is important for you to be careful on the road.

qs.s: Je doute ___ capable de tout finir ce soir.
qs.en: I doubt that he is able to finish everything this evening.

qs.s: Il faut ___ au courant avant demain.
qs.en: He needs to be informed before tomorrow.

qs.s: Le directeur préfère ___ présents à la réunion.
qs.en: The director prefers that we be present at the meeting.

qs.s: Il est essentiel ___ prêts à temps.
qs.en: It is essential that we be ready on time.

qs.s: Nous tenons à ce ___ informés de tout changement.
qs.en: We want you to be informed of any change.

qs.s: Il est nécessaire ___ disponibles ce week-end.
qs.en: It is necessary for you to be available this weekend.
I doubt that they will really be on time.
They need to be aware of the risks.

qs.s: Paris ___ la capitale de la France.
qs.en: Paris is the capital of France.
Marie has been a doctor for five years.
I think, therefore I am. (to exist)

qs.s: Dieu ___ — c'est une conviction profonde pour beaucoup.
qs.en: God exists — it is a deep conviction for many.
He left early this morning. (auxiliary: être + partir)

qs.s: Elle ___ arrivée avant tout le monde.
qs.en: She arrived before everyone else. (auxiliary: être + arriver)

qs.s: L'___ humain est une question fondamentale en philosophie.
qs.en: Human existence (being) is a fundamental question in philosophy.

qs.s: Heidegger a consacré sa vie à l'étude de l'___ en tant que tel.
qs.en: Heidegger devoted his life to the study of being as such.

qs.s: L'___ profond d'une personne ne change pas avec l'âge.
qs.en: A person's true essence does not change with age.

qs.s: Ce voyage l'a aidée à découvrir son ___ véritable.
qs.en: This journey helped her discover her true essence.
